INSERT INTO fms.maintenance_occurrences
          (tenant_id, plan_id, asset_id, scheduled_for, status)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'PLANNED')
        ON CONFLICT (plan_id, coalesce(asset_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid),
                     scheduled_for)
        DO NOTHING
        RETURNING id
